comment: Licence record of the Pelorus tester image (ADR-0178, #236), read by licensing.py. Every file in the image belongs to one component below (first match in list order), to a Debian package (dpkg ownership; its copyright file is required), or to an ignore rule that names a reason and an expiry date. A new package, library, licence or file fails the image build until it is recorded here. Components that name `kits` belong to those image kits only (ADR-0180); `forbidden` files and packages fail every kit whoever owns them. Edit this file together with the Containerfile; `licensing.py record` checks it without an image.

files.why: NVIDIA driver and CUDA files come from the host through the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and are never shipped (ADR-0173 decision 5, ADR-0180)

packages.why: only the free Intel media driver from Debian main ships (ADR-0180)
NVIDIA driver packages are never installed; the host supplies the driver (ADR-0180)

ignore.why: files the container runtime mounts or creates, never part of an image layer
package manager and maintainer-script state; the packages it describes are checked by dpkg ownership
configuration written by the Debian base image build and its maintainer scripts; no licensable content of its own
configuration of Debian packages (apt, dpkg, pam, systemd units); the scripts are covered by their packages' copyright files
symlinks and policy script written by update-alternatives and package scripts
hash and bundle links generated by update-ca-certificates from the ca-certificates package
bytecode compiled from the Debian python3 packages at install

components.name: FFmpeg with the Pelorus patch stack
notes: Built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3, never nonfree (tools/tester/check-ffmpeg-licence.sh). FFmpeg's own sources are LGPL-2.1-or-later and GPL parts are enabled; the combined binary is GPL-3.0-or-later.
The exact FFmpeg commit and the Pelorus commit are named at the top of this file; the companion -source image holds the tree as compiled.

components.name: Pelorus filters, bitstream filter and shaders compiled into FFmpeg
notes: Files under ffmpeg-patches/ keep FFmpeg's LGPL-2.1-or-later (ADR-0171). They are compiled into the ffmpeg binary, which is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

components.name: libpelorus
notes: ffmpeg links libpelorus. EUPL-1.2 Appendix lists GPL-3.0 as a compatible licence for the combined work.

components.name: Tester fixtures
notes: The fixtures are not baked into the image; the lock pins their bytes and records their licences, and the report program fetches them once. Each licence is recorded in the lock and listed below.

components.name: Pelorus tester program, schema and gates
Licence texts shipped with the image
notes: Verbatim texts from the repository's LICENSES/ directory.

components.name: This notices file
notes: Generated by tools/tester/licensing.py from tools/tester/licensing.json during the image build.

components.name: Debian source package list of the image
notes: Names the Debian source packages and versions the image installed; the -source image holds them.

components.name: Vulkan loader and tools (Debian libvulkan1, vulkan-tools)
notes: Debian's copyright files are shipped under /usr/share/doc; the source is in the -source image.

components.name: Python interpreter and standard library (Debian python3)
notes: The report program needs the standard library (shutil, tempfile, urllib), so the image installs python3, not python3-minimal.

components.name: FFmpeg nv-codec-headers (NVENC/NVDEC API headers and dynamic loader)
notes: Compiled into ffmpeg: the headers' loader opens the host driver's libcuda.so.1 and libnvidia-encode.so.1 at run time. No NVIDIA library is in the image; the NVIDIA Container Toolkit mounts the driver with --gpus all.
NOTICE.txt holds the copyright and permission notice of each header; the tree at the pinned commit is in the -source image under /source/kit/nv-codec-headers.

components.name: Intel GPU user-mode stack from Debian main (Mesa Vulkan drivers, oneVPL, free media driver, VA-API)
notes: intel-media-va-driver is the free build (Debian main); intel-media-va-driver-non-free is a forbidden package. The copyright file of each package under /usr/share/doc is authoritative for its licences; the source is in the -source image.

components.name: dav1d AV1 decoder (Debian libdav1d7)
notes: FFmpeg links it (--enable-libdav1d) so the steering smoke decodes the AV1 streams of av1_nvenc and av1_qsv in software, independent of the encoder's vendor stack. The licence text is the package's copyright file.
